'''Vor Deo''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] situated in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]]. Located on the [[Old Corellian Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and at the endpoint of the [[Cranan-Excarga Route/Legends|Cranan-Excarga Route]], during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], an increasing number of illegal cargoes [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] to Vor Deo led the Imperial authorities to concentrate [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] efforts there.

==Description==
Vor Deo was a small yet busy [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Vor Deo system/Legends|Vor Deo system]], a part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Old Corellian Run]], which linked it to the [[Khubeaie system/Legends|Khubeaie]] and [[Obana system/Legends|Obana systems]], and it also lay at the endpoint of the [[Cranan-Excarga Route/Legends|Cranan-Excarga Route]] that connected it to the [[Gedi system/Legends|Gedi system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Vor Deo was originally located on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. When that [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route changed its course<ref name="TEA" /> at some point between [[11,000 BBY]] and [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]<ref name="OldCorellianRunDate" /> and as a result no longer ran through Vor Deo, the world remained on the Old Corellian Run.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
By the time of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="TEA" /> which was [[Declaration of a New Order|established]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Vor Deo experienced significant [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] traffic originating from the worlds located beyond the [[Cirus system/Legends|Cirus]] and [[Melnea's World system/Legends|Melnea's World systems]], which lay near the Arkanis [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] border with<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]].<ref name="OuterRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The increasing number of illegal cargoes reaching Vor Deo through the Cranan-Excarga Route concerned Imperial authorities, which as a result concentrated [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] efforts on Vor Deo.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vor Deo was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-17.<ref name="TEA" />
